{"rationale":"Volební komise conducts the chamber's internal elections/appointments to independent bodies (ombudsman, NKÚ board, regulatory council seats, etc.)."}
{"rationale":"The committee also recommends the chamber's decisions on waiving MP immunity for criminal prosecution/detention under Art. 27 of the Constitution."}
{"rationale":"Mandátový a imunitní výbor verifies and validates deputies' mandates and rules on incompatibility of office — core chamber-organization procedure."}
{"rationale":"Petiční výbor receives and forwards citizens' petitions/complaints to authorities and monitors their resolution — a citizen-driven accountability channel."}
{"rationale":"Kontrolní výbor is the chamber's general control body, overseeing NKÚ, government execution of resolutions, and use of coercive means."}
{"rationale":"Organizační výbor sets the chamber's legislative agenda, session schedule, and committee assignments — the core organizational function of the house."}
{"rationale":"Výbor pro mediální záležitosti proposes/elects members of the Czech TV, Czech Radio, and Radio-TV Broadcasting Council supervisory bodies — independent-body appointments."}
{"rationale":"Výbor pro evropské záležitosti is the chamber's designated committee for scrutinizing and transposing EU legislative proposals."}
{"rationale":"Hospodářský výbor also holds jurisdiction over transport, energy, and informatics/digitalization policy."}
{"rationale":"Hospodářský výbor's remit covers industry, trade, consumer protection and business regulation."}
{"rationale":"Ústavně-právní výbor is the chamber's committee for civil and criminal codes, courts, prosecution, and the justice system generally."}
{"rationale":"Výbor pro obranu (Defence) co-owns via the Ukraine armed-conflict measures."}
{"rationale":"Výbor pro sociální politiku covers labor law, pensions, and social welfare policy."}
{"rationale":"Výbor pro veřejnou správu a regionální rozvoj holds direct jurisdiction over state administration, civil service, and local government organization."}
{"rationale":"The committee's regional-development remit also covers spatial planning, building law, and housing policy."}
{"rationale":"Výbor pro zdravotnictví is the chamber's dedicated health-policy committee."}
{"rationale":"Výbor pro životní prostředí is the chamber's environmental-policy committee."}
{"rationale":"Zahraniční výbor (Foreign Affairs Committee) is the gestor for international-treaty ratification."}
{"rationale":"Zemědělský výbor's remit includes veterinary care, animal husbandry, and rural/agricultural environment matters."}
{"rationale":"Výbor pro bezpečnost (Security) co-owns via the police-cooperation treaties."}
{"rationale":"Rozpočtový výbor's jurisdiction explicitly extends to the financial market, currency, securities, and insurance/banking regulation."}
{"rationale":"Rozpočtový výbor is the chamber's budget committee, handling the state budget, final accounts, and taxation."}
{"rationale":"Stálá komise pro práci Kanceláře PS oversees the internal administrative organization of the chamber's own office."}
{"rationale":"Stálá komise pro rodinu a rovné příležitosti covers family policy and equal-opportunity issues, adjacent to social policy."}
{"rationale":"Stálá komise pro Ústavu ČR a parlamentní procedury is explicitly dedicated to constitutional and procedural matters of the chamber."}
{"rationale":"Stálá komise pro hybridní hrozby monitors and scrutinizes state bodies' response to hybrid/disinformation threats — an oversight-type standing commission."}
{"rationale":"Stálá komise pro kontrolu činnosti BIS is a dedicated statutory oversight body for the intelligence service."}
{"rationale":"Stálá komise pro kontrolu Finančního analytického úřadu is a dedicated statutory oversight body for the financial-intelligence unit."}
{"rationale":"Stálá komise pro kontrolu NÚKIB is a dedicated statutory oversight body for the national cyber-security authority."}
{"rationale":"Vyšetřovací komise ke kauze Dozimetr is an ad hoc parliamentary inquiry commission — the literal 'Inquiry' function of this theme."}
